text_block_list.text:
We're staying at a seaside facility for summer camp, aiming to hone our skills.
Just as we were about to begin our training—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer.
Before we begin training, I'd like you to take this.

Oguri Cap rustles through her bag and pulls out a single sheet of paper.
...It appears to be a handwritten questionnaire.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Could you fill it out while I warm up?
Don't worry, it shouldn't take long.
The survey questions were...

"Do you like sweet food?" "Do you like spicy food?"
"Do you have any food allergies?"—all completely food-related.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Almost all of them are simple "yes" or "no" questions,
so it shouldn't take up much of your time... I hope.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Could you fill it out for me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'll leave it in your hands.

While Oguri Cap went on her warm-up jog,
I filled out the questionnaire...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That helps a lot.
I'll look it over before tonight and put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you filled it out thoroughly,
so everything should be fine. Don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to focus on training
and complete today's regimen properly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Half-hearted effort only cuts the enjoyment in half.
Let us move our bodies as much as possible to prepare for tonight.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You don't know?
Starting tonight, there's... hm, wait, is this one of those things?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't keeping it a secret make it more fitting?
What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, quite a dilemma.
For now, I'll think about it after we finish training.

Oguri Cap seemed restless.
I decided to stop asking and get right to training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is this all for today's regimen?
I feel like I could still go for more...
choice_data_list: This is just the right amount.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see... Yes, let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I still need to review the survey you answered,
and I'd like some time to freshen up.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've already scoped it out... but it's my first time doing this.
It's best to leave ourselves plenty of time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's a place I want to take you.
Once you've washed up, wait for me outside the lodge.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...No, we must not. We can't do that, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Enduring hunger after training is painful for me too.
To be completely honest, I want to eat right this second.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
At this hour, the aroma of dinner will drift down the lodge hallway.
Today's menu is said to be tatsuta-age and stew, making it even more fragrant.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, we must endure it.
To achieve our goal, we must overcome the temptation right in front of us.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Please, understand.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'll just check if they can
save some of the tatsuta-age and stew for later, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Until then, Trainer. See you soon.

Oguri Cap hurried off.
—And then...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: We've arrived, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Look at that. Isn't the sheer number of stalls magnificent?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes. I absolutely wanted to have tonight's dinner here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, there are countless food stalls.
Plenty of things you like, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, I'd like to treat you today.
As a token of my daily appreciation and gratitude.
choice_data_list: Is that why you gave me that survey?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I didn't know you as well as you know me.
I needed to find out what would make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just really wanted to treat you.
In my own way... to a full-course meal crafted just for you.
Oguri Cap, who usually only cared about eating, went out of her way to make a survey just to plan a full-course meal for me...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Besides... food always tastes better when eaten with you.
So, I thought it would be wonderful if we could enjoy it together...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That's a relief, then. I'm glad too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Well then, allow me to guide you right away.
First up is the "Super Colossal Jumbo Series."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible. Everything truly lives up to
the name "Jumbo."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The shaved ice comes in bucket size, the okonomiyaki is the size of a floor cushion,
and the takoyaki are the size of baseballs...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That said, shaved ice is basically just a drink,
and okonomiyaki... look, it's mostly cabbage.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: In fact... wouldn't this count as an appetizer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You're excited too, Trainer.
I understand... My heart is pounding with anticipation as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, sir. Two shaved ices and four okonomiyaki, please.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We plan to visit other stalls, so we should start modestly.
If it's not enough, we can always come back for more.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Don't hold back. Feel free to get as many seconds as you want.
choice_data_list: No, there's no way I can eat that mu—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You always support me where I fall short, Trainer.
This is the best way I know how to express my gratitude right now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's my first time doing something like this, so I feel a bit shy...
but please, accept it.

Stuffed to the brim by her overwhelmingly colossal gratitude,
I ended up completely unable to move for quite some time.
